description: Within one hour, Windows Defender is told to ignore a path, process or extension and something is set to start on its own: a service installed, an auto-start service, a scheduled task registered or an auto-start program. UBA rules: defender_exclusion and service_installed / autostart_service / scheduled_task_registered / autostart_persistence. None of these records an account, so a hit describes the machine and is capped at low. The exclusion's time is the registry key's last write (an upper bound): several exclusions written together share one time.
proves: Defender was told to ignore something close to when new persistence appeared
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Something set to start on its own (no account recorded)
